values.note: $26 a night for every standard site in all 2026-2028 rate seasons on recreation.gov; the Forest Service page still shows $22. Extra vehicle $8 a night. Dump station $5 a use.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233173/rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 10-10 and First-come, First-served Season 05-15 to 05-21: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26; same in 2027 and 2028) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233173 ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-furnace-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night', 'Dump Station: $5 per use'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 49 single sites for tent or RV on recreation.gov (30 reservable, 19 first-come), all back-in except pull-through 049; RV lengths 25-65 ft, most 35-50. The entry's 'about 50' matched an older listing.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233173 (49 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites: 30 'Open', 19 'Not Reservable'; Max Vehicle Length 25-65; 049 Pull-Through, the rest Back-In), read 2026-10-25

values.note: recreation.gov: 'Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided' (the Forest Service page's amenity line says restrooms are not available). Day-use picnic area near the lake shore.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233173 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. A day-use picnic area is also available') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-furnace-campground ('Potable water is available at this site', 'Dump Station: $5 per use'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: recreation.gov's 2026 rate seasons run May 15 - October 10.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-furnace-campground ('Seasons of Use: May 9 - October 8'; 'This campground is currently closed for the season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Run by a concessionaire (facility questions (906) 767-1111). 30 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 19 first-come; the first week of the season (May 15-21 in 2026) is first-come. Weekend reservations 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. A reserved site is held until noon the day after arrival. Up to 14 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233173 (rules minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14; 'Additional campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'Reserved Sites will be held until checkout time (NOON) the day following your arrival date'; refunds notice 'the campground concessionaire'; 'For facility specific information, please call (906) 767-1111') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233173 (30 reservable, 19 Not Reservable) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233173/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 to 05-21), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Hiawatha NF campground on the south shore of Lake Superior at Christmas, about 3 miles west of Munising across M-28 from the Kewadin Casino, looking out toward Grand Island. Amid hardwoods; some sites overlook the lake, others sit near Furnace Creek. No lake access from the campground: boat ramps in Munising and at AuTrain. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + per-site catalog + FS page: concession-run, $26 (2026-2028, confirmed; FS page still says $22), 49 back-in sites (one pull-through) to 65 ft, 30 reservable and 19 first-come, no electric, vault toilets, drinking water and a $5 dump station, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night limit, season May 9 - October 8 (FS). Changed count 50 -> 49, max_rig_ft 60 -> 65; added dump, season, pull-through, minimums. Hiawatha alerts list nothing for this campground or M-28. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
